No 585 Shanghai Municipal Council.
Date 20-9-16

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

September 19th 1916

Sir,
The labour leader Han Hwe 韓恢 with others has opened an office at 209 Avenue Joffre Frenchtown. Masons, carpenters and workmen of all classes are invited to register their names there and about 2000 have already done so. A more complete organisation for the protection of labour is apparently what is aimed at. Han Hwe is also trying to raise money to open a bank to be called the Kong Nyi Nyung Aung 工農銀行 (the labouring classes bank). Shares are $100 each and the object of the bank is to provide poor people of the working class with small capital at low interest with which they can have a chance of becoming independent of the present ring of employers.
The Acting Chief of the Police is arranging to call Han Hwe to his office to warn him.
It is reported that Huang Hsin 黃興 is gathering together his old followers and also the followers of the deceased Chen Chi Mei 陳其美 with the object of concentrating in Hupeh and opposing any hostile move by the Tuchuns there who do not appear to be in sympathy with the Peking Government.
General Chang Hsun has placed orders in Shanghai for 2200 suits of winter uniforms for the troops.
The new Taoyin Zee Nyen An 徐恩元 arrived on the 18th inst and is living at the Wang Yen Li Kwe Hupeh Road.
Tsai Da Pei 蔡大培 the noted revolutionary left for Nankin by the night train on the 18th.

Your Obedient Servant,
McCluskey
Chief Detective Inspector.

P 19a
Captain Superintendent of Police.

第 585 号 上海工部局。
日期 16-9-20

（印章：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探股）

1916年9月19日

先生：

劳工领袖韩恢（Han Hwe）与其他人在法租界霞飞路209号开设了一处办事处。泥瓦匠、木匠及各阶层工人均被邀往该处登记姓名，目前已有约2000人登记。显然，其目的在于建立一个更为完善的劳工保护组织。韩恢还试图筹集资金，开设一家名为“工农银行”（Kong Nyi Nyung Aung）的银行（即劳工阶级银行）。每股金额为100元，该银行的宗旨是以低息向贫困的工人阶级提供小额资本，使其有机会摆脱当前雇主集团的束缚。

代理警务处长正安排传唤韩恢至其办公室予以警告。

据报，黄兴（Huang Hsin）正在召集其旧部以及已故陈其美（Chen Chi Mei）的追随者，目的是在湖北集结，并反对当地督军任何敌对举动；这些督军似乎并不同情北京政府。

张勋将军已在上海订购了2200套部队冬装制服。

新任道尹徐恩元（Zee Nyen An）于本月18日抵达，现居住在湖北路王延里（Wang Yen Li Kwe）。

著名革命党人蔡大培（Tsai Da Pei）于18日乘夜车前往南京。

您顺从的仆人，
麦克卢斯基（McCluskey）
首席侦探督察。

P 19a
警务处总监。
